module: DOCX image references in body order

finding.title: DOCX fallback body-order Markdown loses embedded images
finding.provenance: Generated real DOCX with before text, 200x150 PNG, after text; actual DocxParser.parse + process pool returns images map size1 but no ref in Markdown. Docx2Parser uses DocxParser after Markitdown fallback; Go ImageResolver stores only referenced refs, so omitted image is never stored. No user docs or mocked converter used.
passing_commands: python -m unittest docreader.tests.test_docx_merge docreader.tests.test_docx_tables docreader.tests.test_parser_routing docreader.tests.test_source_locator
finding.validation: Generated real DOCX/PNG fixtures. Before: 2/3 durable cases failed because images map existed without Markdown refs; image-only control already passed. After: all22 DOCX table/image tests, 63 related Python tests, real production ProcessPool public parse test (2.739s), Go docparser (3.257s) pass. Tests use isolated frozen Python3.12 venv, no user dependencies changed. Durable tests reuse existing thread-backed page execution test helper; separate integration runs production process pool. Existing first-image-per-paragraph and direct-paragraph extraction behavior is unchanged; this fix retains extracted refs in body order, not a claim of all Word drawing coverage.

root_review: All production diff and tests reviewed; paragraph index propagated through actual process result and document body composition; Python process/related suite/Go log tails verified.
limitations: Direct-body first extracted image per paragraph remains existing behavior; tables/content-control images not newly supported.
DOC conversion empty-result fallback remains separate pending finding.
